## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My change is small and focused (or split from a larger change).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I have run `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and
      `uv run --directory apps/api pytest` / `uv run --directory workers/execution pytest` locally.
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation.
- [ ] I have not introduced secrets or committed `.env` files.
